answer: We establish Sybil resistance in autonomous networks by anchoring agent identities within a recursive zero-knowledge reputation tree built upon the willow protocol. Each agent must commit significant staking collateral subject to automatic slashing penalties triggered by a cryptographic beacon if double-signing is detected. This cryptoeconomic structure, augmented by zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions that force an echo period for epoch transition, guarantees negative expected attack utility and enforces a robust Nash equilibrium.
